title: labels.json — hand-labelled ground truth (Task 1.1)
description: Schema for /tests/fixtures/labels.json. One entry per mix, each carrying its transition list. Loaded by both the Phase 0 notebook (rough subset) and the Phase 2 --eval harness (full set).

path.description: Path to the mix file, relative to the fixtures/mixes directory.

sha256.description: Hash of the file contents, so a mix swap or re-encode is caught rather than silently invalidating labels.

homogeneous_worst_case.description: Task 1.3 — flags the deliberate minimal/industrial-techno set(s) so --eval can report gate performance on them separately.

start_s.description: First frame where the incoming track becomes audible (blend start), or the cut point for a hard cut.

end_s.description: Last frame where the outgoing track is still audible (blend end). Equal to start_s for a hard cut.

center_s.description: Derived as (start_s + end_s) / 2. Stored (not computed on load) so the ±2s gate tolerance is applied against a fixed, auditable number.

genre.description: Free-text genre tag, e.g. 'techno', 'house', 'drum-and-bass'. Kept free-text since genre spread (Task 1.2) is assessed qualitatively, not via a fixed enum.

blend_style.description: long-blend: >=16 bars overlap. short-blend: <16 bars overlap. hard-cut: no overlap (start_s == end_s).

phrase_offset_bars_truth.description: Ground truth for the phrase-offset-exact-match gate metric (base.md §Validation): a manual bar count, at labelling time, of where the incoming track's first downbeat lands relative to the outgoing track's 32-bar phrase grid. Null when the labeller couldn't determine it confidently (e.g. ambiguous phrase structure) — such transitions are excluded from the phrase-exact-match denominator rather than penalized.
